high_level_description: This image is a striking and somewhat eerie illustration featuring a group of dark, shadowy figures with glowing white eyes. The central figure is a person who appears to be crawling or sliding down a set of red stairs, their body contorted in an unnatural position. The figure's face is obscured by the darkness, adding to the mysterious and unsettling atmosphere. The background is a solid, vibrant red, which contrasts sharply with the dark figures and the red stairs. Above the stairs, there is a doorway that leads into a darker, blue-toned room where more of these shadowy figures can be seen.
